name: William Perez
office: City of Inglewood, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: William Perez says he has run a small business in Inglewood for 16 years. His campaign says he supports an affordability agenda that includes helping seniors age safely at home, protecting renters from displacement, and cutting the cost of doing business. He also proposes greater transparency at City Hall, including open books and community-benefit agreements.
